AETHER_OBSERVER.LinkHint: Paste the Foundry link from your story's Vision tab on Aether Observer (Foundry link, Make a Foundry link). Kept on this computer only, so players never see it.
AETHER_OBSERVER.LiveHint: Every few seconds, check whether you have sent a newer map from Vision and update the scene by itself. Walls and lights that haven't changed are left alone (an opened door stays open), and your fog, tokens and drawings are kept. Needs Live Foundry link on in Vision. Kept on this computer only.
AETHER_OBSERVER.GlobalLightHint: Keeps the whole room map lit, so the map's torches and darkness make no difference. Walls still block sight. Applies each time a map is updated. Kept on this computer only.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NoLink: Paste your Vision link first: Game Settings, Configure Settings, Aether Observer.
AETHER_OBSERVER.BadLink: That doesn't look like an Vision link. Copy it again from the story's Vision tab.
AETHER_OBSERVER.Unreachable: Couldn't reach Aether Observer. Check your internet connection and the link.
AETHER_OBSERVER.UploadFallback: Couldn't save the map picture into Foundry, so the scene uses it straight from Aether Observer. It stops showing if you turn the link off.
AETHER_OBSERVER.Done: Brought in {names}: {count} maps, {walls} walls, {doors} doors, {lights} lights.
AETHER_OBSERVER.AutoName: Check for new maps every 5 seconds
AETHER_OBSERVER.AutoHint: Looks for maps you send from Vision (a hex area kept up to date, or a room map you just sent) and brings them in without pressing the button. Keep this Foundry window visible, because a browser slows a hidden tab right down.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NothingSent: Nothing has been sent to Foundry yet. On Vision, press Send to Foundry first.
AETHER_OBSERVER.AllUpToDate: Everything is up to date ({count} maps).
AETHER_OBSERVER.GlowName: Glowing mushrooms and crystals give light
AETHER_OBSERVER.GlowHint: In caves, mushrooms and crystals on the map give a small, soft light of their own. Turn this off to leave them out. Applies each time a map is updated. Kept on this computer only.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NoSamples: This version has no sample maps yet. You can still bring in your own with an Vision link.
AETHER_OBSERVER.SamplesUpToDate: The sample maps are already imported ({count}).
AETHER_OBSERVER.WelcomeBody:
Vision makes battle maps and hex maps for your table by voice or typing: rooms, caves, towns, hex areas. This module brings them into Foundry as scenes, with walls, doors and lights.

Try it now, free: open the Scenes tab and press Import sample maps. No account needed.

Your own maps: make them at aetherobserver.com/aether-vision. Linking your own maps to Foundry is part of Aether Observer's paid plans.

Aether Observer is a persistent world journal: you enter events, the world remembers, and a daily record is written. Learn more at aetherobserver.com.

You can delete this entry; it will not come back.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NotesSending: Sending {count} journal entries to Aether Observer…
AETHER_OBSERVER.NotesDone: Session notes on Aether Observer: {created} new, {updated} updated, {unchanged} unchanged.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NotesNothing: Nothing to send: that folder has no journal entries.
AETHER_OBSERVER.ConnectChat:
Connect to Aether Observer

Open this page, sign in, check the code is {code}, and approve. Foundry finishes by itself.
AETHER_OBSERVER.ConnectWaiting: Approve code {code} on Aether Observer (a new tab, or the link in chat). Waiting…
AETHER_OBSERVER.ConnectDenied: Not connected: it was turned down on Aether Observer.
AETHER_OBSERVER.ConnectExpired: Not connected: the code ran out. Press Connect to Aether Observer again.
AETHER_OBSERVER.PickStory: Pick which TTRPG Log this Foundry world uses: press the Aether Observer button in the Scenes tab.
AETHER_OBSERVER.PickStoryHint: Maps and session notes for this Foundry world go to and from this TTRPG Log.
AETHER_OBSERVER.NoStories: This account doesn't run any TTRPG Logs yet. Make one on Aether Observer first.
AETHER_OBSERVER.AccountHint: To stop this connection everywhere, remove it on Aether Observer (Your Foundry connections).
AETHER_OBSERVER.Disconnected: Disconnected. Maps and notes use the pasted Vision link again, if there is one.
AETHER_OBSERVER.UploadNeeded: Couldn't save the map picture into Foundry, so the map wasn't brought in. Check you may upload files (Game Settings, Configure Permissions, Upload New Files) and try again.
